name: Media Folder Management
description: A Windows-Explorer-style folder file manager for organizing media, with per-folder access checks and a rich permission set.
project_description:
This module provides an Windows style file explorer or a Ubuntu style Nautilus.

 

 
 ⚠️ Info 
 This module provides its own "media" entity. 
If you are looking for a integration with Media entities check the Media Folders module. 

 
 
 Back to top 

 Features 
 
 Entity reference widget 
 Folder CRUD permissions 
 Folder inherit permissions 
 Drag to upload 
 Drag and drop to move 
 File lock and file revisions 
 
 
 Back to top 

 Installation 
 
 Install as you would normally install a contributed Drupal module. For further

information, see Installing Drupal Modules. 
 
 
 Back to top 

 Post-Installation 
 Once you've enabled the module, go to "/admin/content/file-explorer"

 
 Back to top 

 Dependencies 
 jQuery UI Droppable
